title: 重力波干涉儀懸吊
subcategoryTitle: 天文儀器與科學感測器
summary: 以 Advanced LIGO 的四級擺（40 kg 熔融石英測試質量、0.4 mm 石英纖維）與 Virgo 的超級衰減器為對象，從地面震動與 10⁻¹⁹ m 的位移目標出發，推導單擺 1/f² 與四級 1/f⁸ 的傳遞函數、擺動稀釋後的熱雜訊、葉片彈簧垂直隔振與致動層級，再整合局部阻尼、雜訊預算、真空安裝與鎖定取得，最後落到懸吊驗收與交接。
summaryEn: Using the Advanced LIGO quadruple pendulum (40 kg fused-silica test mass on 0.4 mm silica fibres) and the Virgo superattenuator as reference designs, the course starts from ground motion and the 10⁻¹⁹ m displacement target, derives the single-pendulum 1/f² and four-stage 1/f⁸ transfer functions, the dilution-reduced thermal noise, blade-spring vertical isolation and the actuation hierarchy, then integrates local damping, noise budgeting, in-vacuum installation and lock acquisition, ending with suspension acceptance and handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求」與「單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement" and "The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「地面震動與測試質量」如何決定重力波干涉儀懸吊的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ground motion and the test mass” determines the key performance of “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力波把 4 km 臂長改變 ΔL = h·L，h ≈ 10⁻²³ 時 ΔL 只有 4×10⁻²⁰ m；而安靜場址的地面在 10 Hz 仍以約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz 的幅度晃動，兩者相差十個數量級。LIGO 把這個差距分給兩層：主動地震隔離平台用慣性感測器與致動器把送到懸吊頂端的運動壓到約 2×10⁻¹³ m，再由四級擺懸吊以被動方式再降近六個數量級，使測試質量在偵測頻帶內只對重力波與熱雜訊有反應。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「地面震動與測試質量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gravitational wave changes the 4 km arm by ΔL = h·L, only 4×10⁻²⁰ m for h ≈ 10⁻²³, while the ground at a quiet site still moves by about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, ten orders of magnitude more. LIGO splits that gap across two layers: active seismic-isolation platforms with inertial sensors and actuators reduce the motion delivered to the top of the suspension to about 2×10⁻¹³ m, and the quadruple pendulum then passively removes nearly six more orders, so that in the detection band the test mass responds only to gravitational waves and thermal noise. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ground motion and the test mass”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「地面震動與測試質量」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Ground motion and the test mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求
knowledge.titleEn: Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement
knowledge.text: 重力波把 4 km 臂長改變 ΔL = h·L，h ≈ 10⁻²³ 時 ΔL 只有 4×10⁻²⁰ m；而安靜場址的地面在 10 Hz 仍以約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz 的幅度晃動，兩者相差十個數量級。LIGO 把這個差距分給兩層：主動地震隔離平台用慣性感測器與致動器把送到懸吊頂端的運動壓到約 2×10⁻¹³ m，再由四級擺懸吊以被動方式再降近六個數量級，使測試質量在偵測頻帶內只對重力波與熱雜訊有反應。
knowledge.textEn: A gravitational wave changes the 4 km arm by ΔL = h·L, only 4×10⁻²⁰ m for h ≈ 10⁻²³, while the ground at a quiet site still moves by about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, ten orders of magnitude more. LIGO splits that gap across two layers: active seismic-isolation platforms with inertial sensors and actuators reduce the motion delivered to the top of the suspension to about 2×10⁻¹³ m, and the quadruple pendulum then passively removes nearly six more orders, so that in the detection band the test mass responds only to gravitational waves and thermal noise.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「重力波干涉儀懸吊」的「地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「觀測站：找回微弱訊號」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement: mechanism and system boundary” in “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Observatory: Recover a Faint Signal” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement" is correct?
options: 只要把干涉儀建在夠安靜的地方，就不需要隔振系統。
重力波把 4 km 臂長改變 ΔL = h·L，h ≈ 10⁻²³ 時 ΔL 只有 4×10⁻²⁰ m。
懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。
optionsEn: Building the interferometer at a quiet enough site removes the need for isolation.
A gravitational wave changes the 4 km arm by ΔL = h·L, only 4×10⁻²⁰ m for h ≈ 10⁻²³, while the ground at a quiet site still moves by about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, ten orders of magnitude more.
More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost.
quiz.explanation: 重力波把 4 km 臂長改變 ΔL = h·L，h ≈ 10⁻²³ 時 ΔL 只有 4×10⁻²⁰ m；而安靜場址的地面在 10 Hz 仍以約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz 的幅度晃動，兩者相差十個數量級。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gravitational wave changes the 4 km arm by ΔL = h·L, only 4×10⁻²⁰ m for h ≈ 10⁻²³, while the ground at a quiet site still moves by about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, ten orders of magnitude more. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地面震動與測試質量」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ground motion and the test mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。平台負責約 10⁻⁹/2×10⁻¹³ ≈ 5×10³，懸吊負責 2×10⁻¹³/10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 2×10⁶。注意 4 km 兩端的鉛垂線夾角為 4000/6.371e6 = 6.3×10⁻⁴ rad，垂直運動以這個比例耦合進臂長方向，所以垂直隔振不能忽略。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰. The platform supplies about 10⁻⁹/2×10⁻¹³ ≈ 5×10³ and the suspension 2×10⁻¹³/10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 2×10⁶. Note that the local verticals at the two ends of a 4 km arm differ by 4000/6.371e6 = 6.3×10⁻⁴ rad, so vertical motion couples into the arm direction at that ratio and vertical isolation cannot be neglected. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用地震儀量場址的地面位移譜，用平台上的慣性感測器量殘餘運動，兩者相除得到平台的實測隔振；把平台殘餘乘以懸吊模型傳遞函數預測測試質量位移，與干涉儀差動臂長（DARM）在 10–20 Hz 的實測雜訊比較，差額即為未建模的耦合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the site's ground displacement spectrum with seismometers and the residual motion with the platform's inertial sensors, their ratio being the achieved platform isolation; multiply the platform residual by the suspension model transfer function to predict test-mass displacement and compare with the measured differential arm-length (DARM) noise at 10–20 Hz, the shortfall being unmodelled coupling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。平台負責約 10⁻⁹/2×10⁻¹³ ≈ 5×10³，懸吊負責 2×10⁻¹³/10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 2×10⁶。注意 4 km 兩端的鉛垂線夾角為 4000/6.371e6 = 6.3×10⁻⁴ rad，垂直運動以這個比例耦合進臂長方向，所以垂直隔振不能忽略。
knowledge.textEn: Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰. The platform supplies about 10⁻⁹/2×10⁻¹³ ≈ 5×10³ and the suspension 2×10⁻¹³/10⁻¹⁹ ≈ 2×10⁶. Note that the local verticals at the two ends of a 4 km arm differ by 4000/6.371e6 = 6.3×10⁻⁴ rad, so vertical motion couples into the arm direction at that ratio and vertical isolation cannot be neglected.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement", which statement holds?
options: 只需要隔離水平方向，因為干涉儀只量水平臂長。
總雜訊就是各項雜訊的線性相加。
需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。
optionsEn: Only horizontal isolation matters because the interferometer only measures horizontal arm length.
Total noise is the linear sum of the individual terms.
Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰.
quiz.explanation: 需求：地面 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz（10 Hz）→ 測試質量 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz，總隔振 10¹⁰。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Requirement: ground 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz → test mass 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz, a total isolation of 10¹⁰. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「地面震動與測試質量」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Ground motion and the test mass” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用地震儀量場址的地面位移譜，用平台上的慣性感測器量殘餘運動，兩者相除得到平台的實測隔振；把平台殘餘乘以懸吊模型傳遞函數預測測試質量位移，與干涉儀差動臂長（DARM）在 10–20 Hz 的實測雜訊比較，差額即為未建模的耦合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the site's ground displacement spectrum with seismometers and the residual motion with the platform's inertial sensors, their ratio being the achieved platform isolation; multiply the platform residual by the suspension model transfer function to predict test-mass displacement and compare with the measured differential arm-length (DARM) noise at 10–20 Hz, the shortfall being unmodelled coupling. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：0.1–0.3 Hz 的海洋微震在風暴期間放大十倍，雖在偵測頻帶之外，卻讓致動器飽和、干涉儀無法維持鎖定；低估微震的隔振設計在冬季會損失大量觀測時間。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The 0.1–0.3 Hz ocean microseism grows tenfold during storms; although outside the detection band, it saturates the actuators and the interferometer cannot hold lock, so an isolation design that underestimates the microseism loses large amounts of winter observing time.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用地震儀量場址的地面位移譜，用平台上的慣性感測器量殘餘運動，兩者相除得到平台的實測隔振；把平台殘餘乘以懸吊模型傳遞函數預測測試質量位移，與干涉儀差動臂長（DARM）在 10–20 Hz 的實測雜訊比較，差額即為未建模的耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the site's ground displacement spectrum with seismometers and the residual motion with the platform's inertial sensors, their ratio being the achieved platform isolation; multiply the platform residual by the suspension model transfer function to predict test-mass displacement and compare with the measured differential arm-length (DARM) noise at 10–20 Hz, the shortfall being unmodelled coupling.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement"?
options: 用地震儀量場址的地面位移譜，用平台上的慣性感測器量殘餘運動，兩者相除得到平台的實測隔振。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
鎖定失敗是光學問題，與懸吊無關。
optionsEn: Measure the site's ground displacement spectrum with seismometers and the residual motion with the platform's inertial sensors, their ratio being the achieved platform isolation.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Lock failures are optical problems unrelated to the suspensions.
quiz.explanation: 用地震儀量場址的地面位移譜，用平台上的慣性感測器量殘餘運動，兩者相除得到平台的實測隔振；把平台殘餘乘以懸吊模型傳遞函數預測測試質量位移，與干涉儀差動臂長（DARM）在 10–20 Hz 的實測雜訊比較，差額即為未建模的耦合。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the site's ground displacement spectrum with seismometers and the residual motion with the platform's inertial sensors, their ratio being the achieved platform isolation; multiply the platform residual by the suspension model transfer function to predict test-mass displacement and compare with the measured differential arm-length (DARM) noise at 10–20 Hz, the shortfall being unmodelled coupling. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 地震雜訊、應變目標與隔振需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise, strain target and the isolation requirement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地面震動與測試質量」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Ground motion and the test mass” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 0.1–0.3 Hz 的海洋微震在風暴期間放大十倍，雖在偵測頻帶之外，卻讓致動器飽和、干涉儀無法維持鎖定；低估微震的隔振設計在冬季會損失大量觀測時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: The 0.1–0.3 Hz ocean microseism grows tenfold during storms; although outside the detection band, it saturates the actuators and the interferometer cannot hold lock, so an isolation design that underestimates the microseism loses large amounts of winter observing time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.title: 單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「單擺傳遞函數」如何決定重力波干涉儀懸吊的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pendulum transfer function” determines the key performance of “Gravitational-wave interferometer suspensions”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單擺的懸點到擺錘的水平傳遞函數為 x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q)，共振頻率 f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l)；在 f ≫ f₀ 時以 (f₀/f)² 衰減，每級貢獻 1/f²，四級串接理想上給出 1/f⁸。代價是每一級都引入一個高 Q 的共振模態，必須在不注入感測器雜訊的前提下加以阻尼；Virgo 的超級衰減器更把倒立擺放在最上層，把起始共振壓到 0.03 Hz 量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「單擺傳遞函數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A single pendulum's horizontal transfer function from suspension point to bob is x_m/x_top = f₀²/(f₀² − f² + i·f·f₀/Q) with resonance f₀ = (1/2π)√(g/l); for f ≫ f₀ it falls as (f₀/f)², each stage contributes 1/f² and four stages ideally give 1/f⁸. The price is a high-Q resonant mode per stage that must be damped without injecting sensor noise; the Virgo superattenuator goes further by placing an inverted pendulum at the top, pushing the first resonance down to the 0.03 Hz level. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pendulum transfer function”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With l = 0.6 m, f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「單擺傳遞函數」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pendulum transfer function”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單擺傳遞函數」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pendulum transfer function” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：l = 0.6 m：f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz。單級在 10 Hz 的衰減 (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³，四級理想值 (4.1×10⁻³)⁴ ≈ 3×10⁻¹⁰。實測隔振通常只有 10⁻⁶ 到 10⁻⁸，因為葉片彈簧的垂直模態（f_v ≈ 2.5 Hz，四級給 (2.5/10)⁸ = 1.5×10⁻⁵）經由約 10⁻³ 的垂直–水平耦合進來，貢獻 1.5×10⁻⁸，遠大於水平路徑。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With l = 0.6 m, f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz. One stage attenuates by (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³ at 10 Hz and four ideal stages by (4.1×10⁻³)⁴ ≈ 3×10⁻¹⁰. Measured isolation is usually 10⁻⁶ to 10⁻⁸, because the blade-spring vertical modes (f_v ≈ 2.5 Hz, four stages giving (2.5/10)⁸ = 1.5×10⁻⁵) enter through roughly 10⁻³ of vertical-to-horizontal coupling and contribute 1.5×10⁻⁸, far above the horizontal path. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以頂端致動器驅動掃頻或白雜訊，用各級的光學槓桿或影子感測器量測運動，得到逐級傳遞函數；與狀態空間模型比較模態頻率與 Q 值，模態頻率偏差應小於 5%；特別檢查 10 Hz 附近的實測衰減是否被垂直耦合支配。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Drive the top stage with swept-sine or white noise from its actuators and measure each stage's motion with optical levers or shadow sensors to obtain stage-by-stage transfer functions; compare mode frequencies and Q values with the state-space model, requiring frequency deviations under 5%; check in particular whether the measured attenuation near 10 Hz is dominated by vertical coupling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: l = 0.6 m：f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz。單級在 10 Hz 的衰減 (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³，四級理想值 (4.1×10⁻³)⁴ ≈ 3×10⁻¹⁰。實測隔振通常只有 10⁻⁶ 到 10⁻⁸，因為葉片彈簧的垂直模態（f_v ≈ 2.5 Hz，四級給 (2.5/10)⁸ = 1.5×10⁻⁵）經由約 10⁻³ 的垂直–水平耦合進來，貢獻 1.5×10⁻⁸，遠大於水平路徑。
knowledge.textEn: With l = 0.6 m, f₀ = (1/2π)√(9.81/0.6) = 0.64 Hz. One stage attenuates by (0.64/10)² = 4.1×10⁻³ at 10 Hz and four ideal stages by (4.1×10⁻³)⁴ ≈ 3×10⁻¹⁰. Measured isolation is usually 10⁻⁶ to 10⁻⁸, because the blade-spring vertical modes (f_v ≈ 2.5 Hz, four stages giving (2.5/10)⁸ = 1.5×10⁻⁵) enter through roughly 10⁻³ of vertical-to-horizontal coupling and contribute 1.5×10⁻⁸, far above the horizontal path.

steps.title: 單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「單擺傳遞函數」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pendulum transfer function” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以頂端致動器驅動掃頻或白雜訊，用各級的光學槓桿或影子感測器量測運動，得到逐級傳遞函數；與狀態空間模型比較模態頻率與 Q 值，模態頻率偏差應小於 5%；特別檢查 10 Hz 附近的實測衰減是否被垂直耦合支配。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Drive the top stage with swept-sine or white noise from its actuators and measure each stage's motion with optical levers or shadow sensors to obtain stage-by-stage transfer functions; compare mode frequencies and Q values with the state-space model, requiring frequency deviations under 5%; check in particular whether the measured attenuation near 10 Hz is dominated by vertical coupling. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鋼絲或石英纖維的小提琴模態（數百 Hz）與葉片彈簧內部模態 Q 值極高，若落在偵測頻帶內而未阻尼或未用陷波濾波處理，會在靈敏度曲線上留下一整排尖峰並在控制迴路中引發不穩定。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Violin modes of the wires or silica fibres (hundreds of hertz) and internal blade-spring modes have extremely high Q; if they fall inside the detection band without damping or notch filtering they leave a comb of sharp lines in the sensitivity curve and can destabilise the control loops.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以頂端致動器驅動掃頻或白雜訊，用各級的光學槓桿或影子感測器量測運動，得到逐級傳遞函數；與狀態空間模型比較模態頻率與 Q 值，模態頻率偏差應小於 5%；特別檢查 10 Hz 附近的實測衰減是否被垂直耦合支配。
knowledge.textEn: Drive the top stage with swept-sine or white noise from its actuators and measure each stage's motion with optical levers or shadow sensors to obtain stage-by-stage transfer functions; compare mode frequencies and Q values with the state-space model, requiring frequency deviations under 5%; check in particular whether the measured attenuation near 10 Hz is dominated by vertical coupling.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是每一級都引入一個高 Q 的共振模態，必須在不注入感測器雜訊的前提下加以阻尼；Virgo 的超級衰減器更把倒立擺放在最上層，把起始共振壓到 0.03 Hz 量級。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is a high-Q resonant mode per stage that must be damped without injecting sensor noise; the Virgo superattenuator goes further by placing an inverted pendulum at the top, pushing the first resonance down to the 0.03 Hz level.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「懸吊級數越多永遠越好，沒有代價。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More suspension stages are always better and come at no cost." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鋼絲或石英纖維的小提琴模態（數百 Hz）與葉片彈簧內部模態 Q 值極高，若落在偵測頻帶內而未阻尼或未用陷波濾波處理，會在靈敏度曲線上留下一整排尖峰並在控制迴路中引發不穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Violin modes of the wires or silica fibres (hundreds of hertz) and internal blade-spring modes have extremely high Q; if they fall inside the detection band without damping or notch filtering they leave a comb of sharp lines in the sensitivity curve and can destabilise the control loops.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單擺低通濾波與多級擺鏈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "The pendulum as a low-pass filter and multi-stage chains" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
纖維越粗越安全，而且對雜訊沒有影響。
鋼絲或石英纖維的小提琴模態（數百 Hz）與葉片彈簧內部模態 Q 值極高，若落在偵測頻帶內而未阻尼或未用陷波濾波處理，會在靈敏度曲線上留下一整排尖峰並在控制迴路中引發不穩定。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Thicker fibres are safer and have no effect on noise.
Violin modes of the wires or silica fibres (hundreds of hertz) and internal blade-spring modes have extremely high Q.
quiz.explanation: 鋼絲或石英纖維的小提琴模態（數百 Hz）與葉片彈簧內部模態 Q 值極高，若落在偵測頻帶內而未阻尼或未用陷波濾波處理，會在靈敏度曲線上留下一整排尖峰並在控制迴路中引發不穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Violin modes of the wires or silica fibres (hundreds of hertz) and internal blade-spring modes have extremely high Q; if they fall inside the detection band without damping or notch filtering they leave a comb of sharp lines in the sensitivity curve and can destabilise the control loops. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
